main.description: etzhayyim 主宰者 or partner religious-corp が **法人債務リストラ** rite を宣言。HIPC / Paris Club / Brady Bond / Chapter 11 / scheme of arrangement / 会社更生 / debt-for-nature swap。voluntary multi-creditor consent 前提、強制力なし。Council Lv9 chair × 3 + Five-Bootstrap consultation 必須 (ADR-2605202000)。

scope.description: Free-text scope (jurisdictions, sectors, creditor coalitions). Sovereign rites name the country + creditor body; corporate rites name the entity + impaired classes.

doctrinalBasis.description: Required citation (UNCTAD Sovereign Debt Workout 2015 / 11 USC §1126(c) / 会社更生法 §86 / HIPC framework 1996)

consentThresholdPermille.description: Required cross-creditor consent threshold in permille (per-mille — so ≥ 2/3 = 667). Per-rite-type baselines: sovereign_multilateral=750, sovereign_bilateral=500, corporate_chapter_11=667, corporate_workout=900, debt_for_nature_swap=600. Higher values may be set per rite.

jurisdictionsCovered.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 codes the restructuring scope covers (sovereign debtor jurisdiction + creditor-coalition member states)

issuerDid.description: DID of the declaring religious-corp / authority. Council Lv9 chair × 3 ratification required downstream.
